card.name: Inside capitalized boxed-warning words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long medical words in all-caps boxed warning headings, such as ADOLE-SC-ENTS, ENCEPH-AL-OPATHY and SUICID-AL. Also weakly on pieces of words like Gran-ules or syring-es.

modes.label: Caps warning headings
modes.description: A word piece inside an all-caps WARNING title that is split into several parts.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL IDEATION IN CHILDREN AND ADOLE<<SC>>ENTS Atomoxetine increased the risk of suicidal

modes.label: Lowercase word endings
modes.description: A plural or ending piece after a partial dosage-form word.
modes.example: Gran<<ules>> by Body Weight in Pediatric Patients Aged

card.plain: It fires partway through long capitalized words in boxed warning titles, such as adolescents or encephalopathy.
